name: Symbl.ai
description: Symbl.ai is a cutting-edge AI platform that provides advanced conversational intelligence capabilities. It enables developers and businesses to integrate real-time speech-to-text, sentiment analysis, topic detection, and other AI-driven insights into their applications. With Symbl.ai, users can enhance their communication tools, improve customer interactions, and gain valuable insights from conversations.

events.d: Submit text to create a conversation and process the content.
Append text to a conversation that you previously processed.
Submit audio using a URL to create a conversation and process the content.
Append audio to an existing conversation using a URL and process the content.
Submit video using a URL to create a conversation and process the content.
Returns a list of conversations that you previously processed.
Append video to an existing conversation using a URL and process the content.
Get the status of an async processing job using the job ID.
Permanently deletes the conversation and all related entities such as messages, insights, and topics.
Get members (unique speakers) in a conversation using a conversation ID.
Get action items for a conversation.
Returns a list of bookmarks in a conversation. By default, all bookmarks are returned.
